g.title: ESP32
g.text: ESP32 devboard (ESP-WROOM-32, USB-C), socketed on the carrier
Only the pins used on this sheet are shown. USB = micro-ROS link (UART0, 921600). Unused: GPIO36 battery ADC, GPIO39 rain. GPIO2 = status LED.
